title: Temporal matching in trees
summary: We study maximum matching problems in temporal graphs whose underlying graph is a tree. We consider two temporal models. In a $Δ$-matching, selected time edges sharing an endpoint must have time ticks differing by at least $Δ$. In a $γ$-matching, the selected objects are blocks of $γ$ consecutive appearances of the same underlying edge. We also consider the related ordered static problem of $d$-distance matchings.
